title: Exact massless scalar on a conformally flat external metric

items.title: Exact massless scalar on a conformally flat external metric
items.statement: Assume AC_omega; on R4 with eta=(-,+,+,+), smooth positive dimensionless Omega, and prescribed g=Omega^2 eta, define P_g=Box_g-R_g/6 and Phi_g(f)=Phi_0(Omega^3 f) for compact tests. Prove the exact scalar curvature and wave intertwining identities, the conditional massless Fock field equation and positive vacuum state, local commutativity, formal symmetry, and the two-point kernel relative to the curved volume. No generic curved-state, renormalized stress-tensor, massive/minimal-coupling, Einstein-equation, or backreaction claim.

references.title: Christopher J. Fewster, Lectures on quantum field theory in curved spacetime, Lecture Note 39/2008, §3.1
L. H. Ford, Quantum Field Theory in Curved Spacetime, arXiv:gr-qc/9707062v1, §§1.1–1.2

title: Exact massless scalar on a conformally flat external metric — Examples

items.title: Constant conformal factor verifies field and volume normalization
items.statement: For a constant conformal factor b>0, the theorem gives g=b^2 eta, R_g=0, P_g=b^-2 Box_eta, field smearing by b^3, volume density b^4, and two-point kernel b^-2 relative to curved volume. Direct double smearing yields b^6 times the flat covariance.
